caption:
🌟 A unique opportunity for indie game developers!

🎮 Participate in the Indie Game Studio Demo Day and showcase your game project to experts and investors. 

🏆 Don't miss the chance for recognition of your talent and innovations on a national and global scale!

Event Speakers:
Burak Yılmaz: Managing Director of WePlay VC
Saltukhan Gulsen: Investment Management Lead of WePlay VC

Join us for a day filled with innovation, creativity, and endless possibilities.

❗️ Register to the event to pitch your game as a team or register as a guest by the link in the profile description.
